annotations.title: Stop adding a property to Fabrica

description: Stop adding a property the connected person is adding to Fabrica (Ethereum Mainnet), as that person: its record and its page on fabrica.land are deleted, and it leaves get_my_properties_being_added. Checks first that the property is still being added (a property already set up is refused), that the connected account holds it, and that no listing the owner confirmed is open on it (cancel_land_order takes one down first); a listing the owner has not confirmed yet is taken off the marketplace before the record goes, which needs the listing grant ("Prepare listings for you to review and confirm, and take your listings and offers off the market"). Nothing was signed, paid or recorded for a property still being added, and the setup fee authorized for it is not charged. Final: add_land starts the property again from scratch. Needs the add-property grant ("Start, change, or cancel adding a property to your account").
